type_overrides.reason: Decision 2026-10-17 (docs/17 A2): The Ghan and the Indian Pacific (both Journey Beyond) are the only long-distance passenger rail across Australia, so both are Intercity, not Other (the service=tourism tag would make it Other).

exemptions.reason: The Transperth Midland Line (Perth to Midland) is shared with Journey Beyond's Indian Pacific and Transwa's long-distance trains, so the track took the most prominent route type (Intercity) while the rest of the Transperth network is Regional. The suburban line is drawn consistently Regional; the Indian Pacific, Prospector and AvonLink lines stay Intercity.
